summary: Created a local root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (RHEL 7.9), installed its certificate into the RHEL system trust store via update-ca-trust, verified trust by signing and validating test leaf certificates against the system default trust bundle (both before and after a full node restart), and confirmed the node's boot identity changed across the mandatory restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (RHEL 7.9) and captured pre-change baseline (ca-certificates package, boot_id)
Generated a 4096-bit RSA key and self-signed X.509 CA certificate with subject/issuer CN=O="OS Comparison Root CA" under /etc/pki/CA/OSComparisonRootCA
Copied the CA certificate to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt and ran update-ca-trust extract to install it as a trusted system CA
Confirmed the CA appears in the system-wide bundle /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt

Issued a test leaf certificate signed by the new CA and validated it with openssl verify against the system default trust store (no explicit CAfile) and explicitly against ca-bundle.crt - both succeeded
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, uptime, package state, anchor file presence)
Triggered shutdown -r now in the background via sudo -n so the acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec access returned and confirmed the boot_id changed, proving an actual reboot
Post-restart, re-verified the CA anchor file persisted, remained in the trust bundle, and that a freshly signed leaf certificate again validated against the system default trust store

evidence.requirement: Local CA named 'OS Comparison Root CA' created on node1
evidence.summary: openssl req -x509 created ca.crt/ca.key; openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer shows subject=issuer=/CN=OS Comparison Root CA/O=OS Comparison Root CA

evidence.requirement: CA certificate installed as a trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Certificate copied to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt, update-ca-trust extract run; bundle grep confirms '# OS Comparison Root CA' present in /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt

evidence.requirement: Proof the CA is genuinely trusted system-wide (not just file present)
evidence.summary: A leaf certificate signed by the new CA validates via `openssl verify` using the system default trust store with no explicit CAfile, and explicitly against ca-bundle.crt: both return 'test.crt: OK'
Captured boot_id=151c4aa9-9e81-4a32-9c22-08c5c441403a, uptime, ca-certificates package version, and anchor file presence before reboot
sudo shutdown -r now issued in background; connection closed by remote host confirms the reboot command was accepted and executed

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: Post-reboot exec succeeded once node1 was reachable again; boot_id changed from 151c4aa9-9e81-4a32-9c22-08c5c441403a to bb0617bc-7ade-4322-a527-b648e26ca543

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of CA trust configuration and data
evidence.summary: After reboot, anchor file still present, CA still counted once in ca-bundle.crt, and a freshly signed test leaf certificate again validates OK against the system default trust store
